name: ARK: Survival Evolved
tagline: Exact-build native Linux connector and Generic sidecar for ARK dedicated servers.
requirements: ARK Linux dedicated server build 21241282 with the cataloged executable SHA-256
Docker or Node.js 22 for the sidecar

assets.label: Native server plugin
assets.hint: Run the shipped TakaroArkNative/launch.sh against the exact server root; it verifies the executable before loading the plugin.

assets.label: Generic sidecar
assets.hint: Run in the server network namespace with the native bearer token.
